tasks_completed.description: RC-2: Empty-dict guard for protected fields in merge_agent_slots
tasks_completed.rationale: Naive dict.update() in _merge_existing_slots silently overwrote populated timeline/meals/etc with empty dicts when an agent submitted `{}`. This caused Days 8-11 timeline to be wiped silently. Added PROTECTED_FIELDS frozenset + _is_destructive_empty_overwrite + _safe_overlay helper that refuses such overwrites and logs to stderr.

tasks_completed.description: RC-3: isinstance guards + split_day support in sync-agent-data.py
tasks_completed.rationale: Five sites iterated timeline.items()/values() without checking entry type. A boolean (split_day) accidentally living in a timeline dict would crash entry.get('transit') with AttributeError. Added isinstance(entry, dict) guards in _is_transit, _collect_non_accom_end_times, _find_accom_entry. Also added _build_timeline_by_day + _extract_day_timeline + _merge_split_day_timeline so split_day:true days now merge their `shared`/`matilde`/`jade` sub-keys into the timeline view.
_check_day_overlaps iterated timeline.items() and called entry.get('transit') without type check. Added `if not isinstance(entry, dict)` guard.

tasks_completed.description: RC-4: Tighten day_entry.additionalProperties from true to false
tasks_completed.rationale: day_entry was permissive (additionalProperties: true) which let typo'd or unknown keys leak silently into production data. Enumerated all 11 keys actually present in production timeline.json (day, date, location, location_local, timeline, travel_segments, warnings, split_day, shared, matilde, jade), declared them in properties{}, then set additionalProperties: false. Schema validates existing data with zero new day_entry errors.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — defensive fixes for silent data loss pattern; root cause is naive dict.update() in merge function
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Single-shot edits in three layers (merge function, sync iteration, schema permissiveness) combined to allow an empty agent payload to silently wipe populated data without error or warning
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Defense in depth: (1) merge layer refuses empty-dict overwrites of protected fields, (2) iteration layer guards against non-dict entries so a malformed value can't crash sync, (3) schema layer rejects unknown keys at the day_entry level so typos surface immediately

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Quality-gate no-net-worsening requirement forced extraction of inline guards into named helpers (_is_destructive_empty_overwrite, _warn_empty_overwrite, _valid_end_time, _timeline_end_times, _merge_split_day_timeline, _extract_day_timeline, _build_timeline_by_day). Without these extractions, edits would have inflated existing functions past their pre-edit line counts and been rejected. The schema also expanded to enumerate all 11 day_entry keys (RC-4 explicit allowlist requirement).
